name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd
title: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd - 542812 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Fluoropolymers capacity near full utilisation drives new capex (INR250 cr), R-32 at 10,000t of 20,000t target, but battery materials revenue is pre-qualification and EV spend (~INR2,000 cr to date) is heavy against thin revenue.

utilisation.quote: we are seeing that whatever c apex are made last couple of years, we are almost at the complete utilization cycle of those products in this financial year

capex.quote: GFL has earmarked INR 3,150 crores of capex for FY '27, of which INR2,300 is for GFCL EV and INR850 crores for GFL.

triggers.label: Fluoropolymer capacity nearing full use
triggers.quote: we are almost at the complete utilization cycle of those products in this financial year

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR3,150 cr incl. INR850 cr GFL
triggers.quote: GFL has earmarked INR 3,150 crores of capex for FY '27

triggers.label: Inventory days rising, working capital cycle high
triggers.quote: our average working capital cycle remains high

triggers.label: Fluoropolymer price increase taken
triggers.quote: There has been a price increase. We have also taken a price increase

guidance.metric: Battery materials cumulative capex by FY28
guidance.quote: we remain committed to our previously outlined guidelines of INR6,000 crores cumulative capex by FY '28

guidance.metric: Battery materials asset turns and EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: targeted asset turns of nearly 2x and EBITDA margins of over 25% plus
we expect to see a growth of around 15% to 20% as compared to the last year in our fluoropolymers products
we have announced that we'll be going up to 20,000 tons in R-32

guidance.value: 3-digit INR crores quarterly by Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: we expect to reach, of course, the 3- digit number by the end of this quarter

prior_guidance_check.quote: The production has already started. As I said last time that we have achieved over 10,000 ton capacity at the moment.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Battery materials INR6,000 crores capex by FY28
prior_guidance_check.quote: we remain committed to our previously outlined guidelines of INR6,000 crores cumulative capex by FY '28

red_flags.label: Battery EBITDA loss jump; one-off FX loss on buyer's credit
red_flags.quote: that was unexpectedly onetime loss that will not recur in future because we have M2M

red_flags.label: Inventory days rising; working capital cycle high
red_flags.quote: our average working capital cycle remains high

red_flags.label: Management won't disclose EV contract terms
red_flags.quote: I'm not really at liberty to give details of our contracts, Arun.

evasions.quote: I'm not really at liberty to give details of our contracts, Arun.
it would be difficult for me to give an exact number

evasions.topic: Fluoropolymer PTFE vs new polymer growth split
evasions.quote: so far, we have not been giving any breakup of growth of respective fluoropolymers

evasions.topic: Oman capex and R-32 further capacity
evasions.quote: We have time, and we will take that call as we go along
